say: This video shows the Raw Text paper type for inpatient payment and deposit receipts. Raw Text sends the receipt straight to a dot-matrix printer, without the browser's print dialog.
Open the Payments menu and click Payment Management.
Expand Inward Deposit, and click Payment.
Type the patient's name or BHT number, pick the admission, and click select.
Choose Cash, enter the amount, and click Pay.
The receipt opens. Raw Text is off in this department, so the page shows the usual paper preview, and prints through the browser.
To change this, click Settings, next to the title. You need the Change Receipt Printing Paper Types privilege.
In the Raw Text card, tick Use Raw Text paper in this department. The setting applies only to the department you are logged in to.
The same card sets the layout: top margin, line width, pre-printed stationery, and which patient details to show. Here we change the line width to 48 characters, and click Apply and Close.
The page now shows an approximate preview of the dot-matrix print, at the new width. The print button is now Print, Raw Text, at the far right.
Click Print, Raw Text. The receipt downloads as a P R N file.
This is the downloaded file. The print agent on the cashier's computer sends it straight to the dot-matrix printer.
Each cashier computer needs a one-time setup. Open Raw text printer setup, under the preview. It lists five steps, with a button to download the print agent, and a link to the full guide.
Reprints work the same way. Go back to Payment Management, and under Inward Deposit, click Payment Search.
Enter the BHT number, click Search, and then click the bill number.
The reprint shows the original and the duplicate, side by side, with Print Original and Print Duplicate Raw Text buttons.
To go back to normal paper, open Settings and untick Use Raw Text paper. Deposit receipts and deposit reprints work the same way.
